text: Which accessories are worth buying for a Barista Express or Barista Pro (scale, tamper, distribution tool, bottomless portafilter, baskets) and which are not?

attempts.why: No card yet. The only readable accessory discussions (bottomless portafilter, WDT, shower screen) were in an OzBargain thread from 2024-06-22, which is older than 24 months, and in a 2025 thread I already used for the cleaning card. Reddit, Home-Barista and Coffee Forums UK were blocked. Retry when better sources are reachable.

No card this run, for lack of readable owner evidence, not for lack of interest. I searched for accessories worth buying for the Express/Pro: scale, tamper, WDT, puck screen, bottomless portafilter and baskets. The only owner discussions I could open were OzBargain deal threads: node 861855 (2024-08-16, Breville owners arguing about whether stock baskets need replacing), node 795966 (2023) and node 831623 (2024-02-15). They are either older than 24 months or don't come from Express/Pro owners. The one in-window thread with Express accessory advice (OzBargain 916284) is already the evidence for the sour/bitter card, so I couldn't reuse it. Most results were retailer 'best upgrades' blogs (coffeenerd, shotandscale, yozcoffee), which aren't demand. The places where this is really asked (r/espresso, Home-Barista, Coffee Forums UK, Slickdeals) all returned 403 or failed. Worth retrying when Reddit signals come through.

No card this run. The main places these owners talk were unreachable. Reddit is blocked for both search and fetch. Home-Barista and CoffeeGeek return 403. Coffee Forums UK redirects to a bot host that doesn't resolve, so its bottomless-portafilter threads for the Sage Barista Express showed up only as search leads. Slickdeals and Whirlpool also return 403. I could read three threads. A Singletrack off-topic thread (2024-01-04, older than 24 months, an unrelated community's general board): a secondhand Sage Barista Express owner asks for tips, and replies suggest single-wall baskets, WDT and a dosing funnel. A PistonHeads food board thread (2025-01-06): a buyer choosing a machine, where one reply recommends a funnel for the Express. That's a reply, not an owner asking the accessory question. A CoffeeSnobs Barista Pro owners thread (2021, older): one owner asks which accessories to buy. Search results are full of retailer 'best Barista Express accessories' blog posts, which is supply, not demand. I found no recent owner asking this that I could actually read, so the seed stays open. A later run with the scheduler's Reddit and YouTube signals enabled (both were skipped today: no API keys) should find it more easily.
